decisions: Dropped 'an OTP every time the app is opened' - not on cost but because the check does not work: an SMS code proves possession of the SIM, and on a reopen the SIM is in the handset the person is holding. Every reopen asks for the device credential instead
The OTP is six digits. Firebase sends six and it is not configurable, so the artboard's four boxes cannot accept the code that arrives. Forced, not chosen
Firebase for messaging and SMS, never for identity - FirebaseOtpVerifier throws the Firebase user away and reports only whether the code was right
Phase 3.5 pulled forward because dark mode was finished and unreachable
Both call routes will be built, on competitive parity rather than privacy. Matrix rejected
A UI tick is earned per element, not per screen
Device tests are debug builds always - the driver needs the Dart VM service

Biometrics verified end to end on real hardware - both availability branches, a real prompt, a real fingerprint reopening a locked session

Dark mode is reachable and the choice survives a restart
The VPS is up and all four containers returned healthy on their own

The OTP confirm half is unconfirmed - codeSent is proven, signInWithCredential accepting a typed code has never been seen in a log because success only started logging at the end
No backend: a sent request never becomes a booking, a review is dropped

Nothing reads keepScreenOnDuringRides yet - Phase 5 owns that
doNotRepeat: A seam that discards the cause is not observable: _readFailure dropped e.code so a real failure surfaced as 'could not send a code' with nothing saying why. Logging only the failure branch is the same bug half-fixed
A sleeping screen kills an on-device gate and names nothing useful, and NO screenshots survive because the driver flushes at the end
An AnimatedSwitcher's outgoing child animates on the controller it was built with
'Has it changed' is not 'is it different from where it started'

lastCommit.subject: Build the booking status screen: all eleven states

archive.summary: Read the design properly and repaired everything built on a partial reading of it. Five rounds of user pushback, each correct: the design project was reachable all along; only one canvas of five had been read; docs must precede Dart; wrong documentation is an emergency because everything downstream inherits it; and the flattener was stripping <script>, which is where the design keeps PAL, CATS, REQUIREMENTS and all eleven BSTATES. Brand imported and shipped - launcher, adaptive, splash and notification icons all real and verified on device. Colour and type verified against the canvas rather than assumed. Booking status built with all eleven states.

Followed docs/build-order.md rather than re-deriving it. Closed Phase 0 by running all five built screens on a Pixel 9a in both modes - the first time this app has been seen rendered. The palette came back exact; the supply count was ellipsised and is fixed. The run exposed that the app has no identity at all, raised by the user mid-session: stock Flutter icon, white cold-start flash, no mark. Fixed what needed no artwork, made the rest an enforced artifact. Then built Phase 1 in full: seven entry routes plus the auth gate, with the entry rules held as states in core/session.dart. 147 tests.
